worldcombat.skill.ragingfury.summary: Charge forward spewing flames in bursts: enemies along the line are burned, set alight and shoved back, and each landing leaves a smoldering patch that keeps igniting anyone standing in it; afterwards the user reels in confusion and its actions may fumble.
worldcombat.skill.ragingfury.use.0: Sweep a line of enemies with flames and set them alight
worldcombat.skill.ragingfury.use.1: Drop a lasting burning patch across a chokepoint
worldcombat.skill.ragingfury.use.2: Burn a close opponent away and force it off its spot
worldcombat.skill.ragingfury.description: Charge forward spewing flames for %2$s bursts; each burst turns toward the nearest enemy within 16 blocks (or follows your aim if none), dealing about %1$s fire damage to each enemy in the flame line.

Each burst first steps up to %2$s blocks toward the foe, then sweeps a flame line up to %1$s blocks long with a %4$s block radius (half-width); bursts are %3$s apart, and a hit shoves people %5$s blocks outward.

Each burst's landing leaves a %1$s block smoldering patch lasting %2$s; enemies standing in it are repeatedly set alight, and anyone caught by the line or stepping into the patch is set alight for %3$s.
Afterwards the user reels in confusion for %1$s: each attempted action has a %2$s chance to be disrupted, the disrupted attempt takes a little spark-backlash damage, and the daze is renewed.
worldcombat.skill.ragingfury.inferno.on: Inferno form: the smoldering patch is larger, lasts longer and ignites longer with slightly lower damage per burst, but the charge is shorter with a slower wind-up and cooldown and a longer daze.
worldcombat.skill.ragingfury.inferno.off: Stampede form: charges further, keeps a faster rhythm and loses control for less time, but the patch left behind is smaller and shorter.
worldcombat.skill.ragingfury.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP; cooldown %5$s s from commitment.
worldcombat.skill.ragingfury.growth.0: From level %1$s each burst rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.ragingfury.growth.1: From level %1$s each burst rises to %2$s and the smoldering radius to %3$s blocks.
On: the smoldering patch is larger and lasts longer and ignites longer, but the charge is shorter with a slower wind-up and cooldown and a longer daze - for holding chokepoints. Off (stampede): charges further, keeps a faster rhythm and loses control for less time, but the patch left behind is smaller and shorter.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger starts sooner, and is easier to whiff.
On: below a third health the target is prioritized. Off: the move keeps its normal priority (the default, as it is more about laying fire).
